description: Single-panel property-versus-composition plot (not a composite): ordinate "Young's modulus (GPa)" scaled 135-185 with major ticks every 5; abscissa "Mn (wt%)" scaled 5-40 with major ticks every 5 and minor ticks every 1. Four drawn features. (i) A red solid curve labelled "as-hot rolled" spans Mn ≈15.5-22 wt%, lying highest, starting at the 180 GPa level and ending between the 165 and 170 GPa gridlines. (ii) Two closely spaced black curves bound a vertically hatched band over Mn ≈11-27.5 wt% between roughly the 158 and 165 GPa gridlines; outside that interval the curves merge into one line, which rises from about the 140 GPa gridline at Mn = 5 wt% to a local maximum near the 165 GPa gridline at Mn ≈11 wt% and, after Mn ≈30 wt%, falls to between the 150 and 155 GPa gridlines at Mn = 40 wt%. (iii) A short blue solid curve spans Mn ≈15.5-25 wt% at the lowest values in the figure (between the 140 and 155 GPa gridlines, ≈143-152 GPa). (iv) Black annotations "as-cold rolled and annealed" and "as-cast" with leader lines into the mid-plot. No numeric data labels are printed. The caption assigns the hatched band to the as-cast state of Fe-(5-40)Mn-10Al-1C steels [30] and the solid lines to Fe-(15-28)Mn-(7-10)Al-(0.7-1.2)C steels after different processing steps [5], all measured by the resonance method.

subfigures.description: Single-panel Young's modulus (GPa) versus Mn (wt%) plot containing a red 'as-hot rolled' solid curve (Mn ≈15.5-22 wt%, highest E), a vertically hatched band bounded by two black curves (Mn ≈11-27.5 wt%, ≈158-165 GPa) with the curves merging outside that range, and a short blue solid curve (Mn ≈15.5-25 wt%, ≈143-152 GPa, lowest). Three text annotations with leader lines label the datasets; no numeric data labels are printed.

observations.observation: The plot's y-axis is labelled "Young's modulus (GPa)" and ticked from 135 to 185 in steps of 5; the x-axis is labelled "Mn (wt%)" and ticked 5 to 40 in steps of 5 with minor ticks every 1 wt%.
A red solid curve labelled "as-hot rolled" spans approximately Mn = 15.5-22 wt% and lies highest in the figure, beginning at the 180 GPa level and ending between the 165 and 170 GPa gridlines.
A vertically hatched band bounded by two closely spaced black curves spans roughly Mn = 11-27.5 wt% and lies between about the 158 and 165 GPa gridlines.

The two black boundary curves merge into a single line for Mn below ~11 wt% and above ~28 wt%; that merged curve rises from the ~140 GPa gridline at Mn = 5 wt% to a local maximum near the 165 GPa gridline at Mn ≈11 wt%, and after Mn ≈30 wt% descends to between the 150 and 155 GPa gridlines at Mn = 40 wt%.
A short blue solid curve spans roughly Mn = 15.5-25 wt% and gives the lowest moduli in the figure, between the 140 and 155 GPa gridlines (≈143-152 GPa).

No numerical data labels are printed on any curve; the only text inside the plotting area is the three annotations "as-hot rolled" (red text), "as-cold rolled and annealed" and "as-cast", whose leader lines both terminate in the mid-plot region near Mn ≈19-22 wt%.

The caption states that the solid lines give Fe-(15-28)Mn-(7-10)Al-(0.7-1.2)C steels after different processing steps [5] and that the dashed band gives the as-cast state of Fe-(5-40)Mn-10Al-1C steels [30].
The caption states that the E moduli were measured using the resonance method.

The citing text states that a relatively low E value is observed in the as-cast state, that it is increased by hot rolling, and that after cold rolling and annealing E is slightly decreased again from the as-hot-rolled value.

The citing text attributes the lower Young's modulus in the as-cast state to casting defects such as shrinkage cavities, segregation among dendritic arms and micro-cavities, and notes that Al widening the primary delta-phase range during solidification promotes cavity formation.

The citing text states that a decrease of around 20% in the Young's modulus is observed for cold rolled strips of Fe-20Mn-(7-10)Al-(0.7-1.2)C steels compared with high strength low alloy (HSLA) grades (E = 210 GPa).

The caption's assignment of the hatched band (~158-165 GPa) to the as-cast state is not obviously consistent with either the drawn data or the citing text, which describes as-cast as the relatively low-modulus state while the blue curve (~143-152 GPa) is the lowest in the figure; the arrowheads of the "as-cold rolled and annealed" and "as-cast" leaders overlap in the Mn ≈19-22 wt% region and cannot be assigned with certainty.

unreadable_items: Which dataset the leader line from "as-cold rolled and annealed" and the leader line from "as-cast" each point to — both arrowheads terminate in the Mn ≈19-22 wt% mid-plot region and cannot be resolved unambiguously at the supplied resolution
Whether the two long black curves are a single scatter band (as the caption's "dashed band" implies) or two separate datasets
Exact end-points of the red as-hot rolled curve and of the blue short curve, which are not data-labelled
